Strategy: Near-tie tightest protection. Rank like Best Fit, except the bin with the smallest residual loses a penalty of half the item size, so a nearly-as-tight bin wins instead. The choice differs from Best Fit when the second-tightest residual is within half the item of the tightest. It may help by preserving the tightest slot for a future item that fits only there, but may fail if the tightest slot is never needed again.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mn = min(bins)
    return [-(r - item) - item / 2 if r == mn else -(r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Near-tie tightest protection: min-residual bin penalized by item/2, else Best Fit.
